sentences.en: A millennium ago, stepwells were fundamental to life in the driest parts of India.
sentences.zh: 一千年前,阶梯井是印度最干旱地区生活的基础。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Richard Cox travelled to north-western India to document these spectacular monuments from a bygone era
sentences.zh: 理查德·考克斯前往印度西北部记录这些过去时代的壮观纪念碑

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: During the sixth and seventh centuries, the inhabitants of the modern-day states of Gujarat and Rajasthan in north-western India developed a method of gaining access to clean, fresh groundwater during the dry season for drinking, bathing, watering animals and irrigation.
sentences.zh: 在六世纪和七世纪期间,现代印度西北部古吉拉特邦和拉贾斯坦邦的居民开发了一种在旱季获取清洁、新鲜地下水的方法,用于饮用、沐浴、给动物浇水和灌溉。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: However, the significance of this invention - the stepwell - goes beyond its utilitarian application.
sentences.zh: 然而,这项发明——阶梯井——的意义超出了它的实用性应用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Unique to this region, stepwells are often architecturally complex and vary widely in size and shape.
sentences.zh: 阶梯井是该地区独有的,其建筑结构通常很复杂,大小和形状差异很大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: During their heyday, they were places of gathering of leisure and relaxation and of worship for villagers of all but the lowest classes.
sentences.zh: 在他们的鼎盛时期,它们是除了最底层之外的所有村民的休闲聚会和礼拜场所。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Most stepwell are found dotted round the desert areas of Gujarat (where they are called baori), while a few also survive in Delhi.
sentences.zh: 大多数阶梯井分布在古吉拉特邦的沙漠地区（在那里被称为“baori”）,而德里也有一些。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Some were located in or near villages as public spaces for the community; others were positioned beside roads as resting places for travellers.
sentences.zh: 有些位于村庄内或村庄附近,作为社区的公共空间；其他的则位于路边作为旅行者的休息处。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: As their name suggests; stepwells comprise a series of stone steps descending from ground level to the water source (normally an underground aquifer) as it recedes following the rains.
sentences.zh: 顾名思义；阶梯井由一系列石阶组成,随着雨水的退去,从地面下降到水源（通常是地下含水层）。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When the water level was high, the user needed only to descend a few steps to reach it; when it was low, several levels would have to be negotiated.
sentences.zh: 当水位较高时,用户只需下降几步即可到达；当价格较低时,就必须协商几个级别。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Some wells are vast, open craters with hundreds of steps paving each sloping side, often in tiers.
sentences.zh: 有些井是巨大的、开放的火山口,每个斜坡都有数百级台阶,通常是分层的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Others are more elaborate, with long stepped passages leading to the water via several storeys.
sentences.zh: 其他则更为复杂,有长长的阶梯通道,通过几层楼通向水边。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Built from stone and supported by pillars, they also included pavilions that sheltered visitors from the relentless heat.
sentences.zh: 它们由石头建造,由柱子支撑,还包括为游客遮挡酷暑的凉亭。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But perhaps the most impressive features are the intricate decorative sculptures that embellish many stepwells, showing activities from fighting and dancing to everyday such as women combing their hair or churning butter.
sentences.zh: 但也许最令人印象深刻的特征是装饰许多阶梯井的复杂装饰雕塑,展示了从打斗和跳舞到日常活动,例如妇女梳头或搅拌黄油。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Down the centuries, thousands of wells were constructed throughout north-western India, but the majority have now fallen into disuse; many are derelict and dry, as groundwater has been diverted for industrial use and the wells no longer reach the water table.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来,印度西北部各地建造了数千口井,但大多数现已废弃；由于地下水已被转用于工业用途,而且水井不再达到地下水位,许多水井都被废弃且干涸。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Their condition hasn't been helped by recent dry spells: southern Rajasthan suffered and eight-year drought between 1996 and 2004.
sentences.zh: 最近的干旱并没有改善他们的状况：拉贾斯坦邦南部在 1996 年至 2004 年间遭受了长达八年的干旱。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: However, some important sites in Gujarat have recently undergone major restoration, and the state government announced in June last year that it plans to restore the stepwells throughout the state.
sentences.zh: 不过,古吉拉特邦的一些重要遗址最近进行了重大修复,州政府去年6月宣布计划修复全邦的阶梯井。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In Patan, the state's ancient capital, the stepwell of Rani Ki Vav (Queen's Stepwell) is perhaps the finest current example.
sentences.zh: 在该州的古都帕坦,Rani Ki Vav（女王阶梯井）的阶梯井也许是当前最好的例子。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It was built by Queen Udayamati during the late 11th century, but became silted up following a flood during the 13th century.
sentences.zh: 它由乌达亚玛蒂 (Udayamati) 女王于 11 世纪末建造,但在 13 世纪的一场洪水后被淤塞。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But the Archaeological Survey of India began restoring it in the 1960s, and today it is in pristine condition.
sentences.zh: 但印度考古调查局在 20 世纪 60 年代开始修复它,如今它仍处于原始状态。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: At 65 metres long, 20 metres wide and 27 metres deep, Rani Ki Vav features 500 sculptures carved into niches throughout the monument.
sentences.zh: Rani Ki Vav 长 65 米、宽 20 米、深 27 米,整个纪念碑的壁龛中雕刻着 500 件雕塑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Incredibly, in January 2001, this ancient structure surviced an earthquake that measured 7.6 on the Richter scale.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是,2001 年 1 月,这座古老的建筑在一场里氏 7.6 级的地震中幸存下来。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Another example is the Surya Kund in Modhera, northern Gujarat, next to the Sun Temple, built by King Bhima I in 1026 to honour the sun god Surya.
sentences.zh: 另一个例子是位于古吉拉特邦北部莫德拉的 Surya Kund,毗邻太阳神庙,由国王 Bhima I 于 1026 年建造,以纪念太阳神 Surya。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It actually resembles a tank (kund means reservoir or pond) rather than a well, but displays the hallmarks of stepwell architecture, including four sides of steps that descend to the bottom in a stunning geometrical formation.
sentences.zh: 它实际上类似于一个水箱（kund 的意思是水库或池塘）而不是一口井,但显示了阶梯井建筑的标志,包括台阶的四个侧面,以令人惊叹的几何结构下降到底部。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The terraces house 108 small, intricately carved shrines between the sets of steps.
sentences.zh: 梯田的台阶之间有 108 个雕刻精美的小型神龛。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Rajasthan also has a wealth of wells.
sentences.zh: 拉贾斯坦邦也有丰富的水井。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The ancient city of Bundi, 200 kilometres south of Jaipur, is renowned for its architecture, including its stepwells.
sentences.zh: 本迪古城位于斋浦尔以南 200 公里处,以其阶梯井等建筑而闻名。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: One of the larger examples in Raniji Ki Baori, which was built by the queen of the region, Nathavatji, in 1699.
sentences.zh: Raniji Ki Baori 中较大的例子之一,由该地区的女王 Nathavatji 于 1699 年建造。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: At 46 metres deep, 20 metres wide and 40 metres long, the intricately carved monument is one of 21 baoris commissioned in the Bundi area by Nathavatji.
sentences.zh: 这座雕刻精美的纪念碑深 46 米,宽 20 米,长 40 米,是 Nathavatji 在 Bundi 地区委托建造的 21 座 baoris 之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the old ruined town of Abhaneri, about 95 kilometres east of Jaipur, is Chand Baori, one of India's oldest and deepest wells; aesthetically it's perhaps one of the most dramatic.
sentences.zh: 在斋浦尔以东约 95 公里处的阿巴内里 (Abhaneri) 老城废墟中,坐落着 Chand Baori,它是印度最古老、最深的井之一；从美学上来说,它可能是最具戏剧性的之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Built in around 850 AD next to the temple of Harshat Mata, the baori comprises hundreds of zigzagging steps that run along three of its sides, steeply descending 11 storeys, resulting in a striking pattern when seen from afar.
sentences.zh: 保里建于公元 850 年左右,毗邻 Harshat Mata 神庙,由数百个锯齿形台阶组成,沿着其三个侧面延伸,陡峭地下降 11 层,从远处看,形成引人注目的图案。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: On the fourth side, verandas which are supported by ornate pillars overlook the steps.
sentences.zh: 在第四侧,由华丽柱子支撑的阳台俯瞰着台阶。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Still in public use is Neemrana Ki Baori, located just off the Jaipur-Delhi highway.
sentences.zh: Neemrana Ki Baori 仍在公共使用,位于斋浦尔-德里高速公路旁。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Constructed in around 1700, it is nine storeys deep, with the last two being underwater.
sentences.zh: 建于 1700 年左右,有九层楼深,最后两层位于水下。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: At ground level, there are 86 colonnaded openings from where the visitor descends 170 steps to the deepest water source.
sentences.zh: 在地面层,有 86 个柱廊开口,游客可以从这里下降 170 级台阶到达最深的水源。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Today, following years of neglect, many of these monuments to medieval engineering have been saved by the Archaeological Survey of India, which has recognised the importance of preserving them as part of the country's rich history.
sentences.zh: 如今,经过多年的忽视,许多中世纪工程的纪念碑已被印度考古调查局保存下来,该调查局认识到将它们作为该国丰富历史的一部分进行保护的重要性。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Tourists flock to wells in far-flung corners of north-western India to gaze in wonder at these architectural marvels from hundreds of years ago, which serve as a reminder of both the ingenuity and artistry of ancient civilisations and of the value of water to human existence.
sentences.zh: 游客们涌向印度西北部偏远角落的水井,惊叹于这些数百年前的建筑奇迹,它们提醒人们古代文明的独创性和艺术性,以及水对人类生存的价值。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
